messages.subject: multi-page app
parts:
Hello!

I got a short question. So let's say I would to develop a multi-page app, where there is a homepage with many buttons or links. And I would like to click one of them to go to another page. I looked at all the examples in the shiny gallery and it seems that all of them have only one web page. 

I know that shiny itself doesn't have a mechanism to do this. But has anyone found a workaround to solve this problem?

Thanks in advance!

Tao

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: multi-page app
parts: I'd love to hear a little more about your scenario. What information needs to be transferred between the first page and the second page? (That's really the first of at least a couple of tricky issues with this kind of thing--the second is what's supposed to happen when you use the browser's back/forward buttons to move between the two pages.)

Thanks for your response. I am really a rookie at web programming. 

To answer your question. I think the first page is supposed to pass a few parameters to the second page, which, for example, will depend on these parameters for some additional analysis and visualization. For the second question. I think the back/forward buttons are supposed to move the web browser between the first and second page. 

Tao
